implemented_behavior: Snapshot-bound approval verification, independently configured reviewer roles, quorum, rejection veto, author/reviewer separation, validity windows, revocation and signed review-evidence hashes.
bounds_and_open_scope: HMAC is operator-provisioned authentication, not independent digital non-repudiation or proof that an expert reviewed a case. Test keys and review statements are synthetic. No real reviewers or production identity integration were supplied.
batch_shared_regression: 254 unique test methods including 38 additional cross-task/audit/CLI/package tests; do not add repeated task runs to this count.
evidence_scope: Local Python execution, unit/contract/metamorphic tests and authored diagnostic cases only.
